name: SwipeActions
description: Swipe a row to reveal trailing actions; dismiss-to-delete; RTL-aware with a keyboard/semantics alternative.
notes: No <name>_style.dart / <name>_theme.dart: actions reuse Button variants and ThemeData tokens, so there is nothing to theme.
The actions are real Buttons: keyboard focus and screen readers reach them once revealed; closed rows exclude them from semantics and focus.
Gap-fill primitive for the P9-3 flows (checkout cart rows, chat threads).
